name: Syarikat Takaful Malaysia Keluarga Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约，主要公告为季度业绩、股东常年大会、公司章程修订、关联方交易授权更新、董事委员会成员变动及公司秘书变更。最新一季（2026年6月30日）营收同比增长16.2%，净利润同比增长6.0%。
overview_en: There were no announcements this year involving business segment expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts. The main announcements were quarterly results, annual general meetings, amendments to the Company's Constitution, renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, changes in board committee memberships, and change of company secretary.
